shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'DropdownMenu.*(d.ts|README)|DropdownMenu/index|DropdownMenu.js' | head -25 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Popup/Popup.d.ts | head -85'

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'controlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts && node -e 'console.log([\"playwright\",\"@playwright/test\",\"puppeteer\"].map(x=>{try{return x+\": \"+import.meta.resolve(x)}catch{return x+\": unavailable\"}}).join(\"\\n\"))'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --no-save --package-lock=false @playwright/test'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && rg -n 'onClick|onKeyDown|aria|closeMenu' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.js | head -35 && ls /usr/bin/*chrom* /opt/*/chrome /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/*/chrome-linux/chrome 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.js | head -125 && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.css | head -70 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -45'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx playwright install-deps chromium --dry-run && command -v apt-get && command -v dpkg-deb'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/browser-libs && cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libdbus-1-3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libdrm2 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libasound2 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libatspi2.0-0 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libharfbuzz0b libthai0 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libxrender1 libpng16-16 libfribidi0 libwayland-server0 libelf1'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc 'for deb in /tmp/browser-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" /tmp/browser-libs/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-linux/headless_shell | rg '"'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248 | head -8
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc "cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libxi6 && dpkg-deb -x libxi6_*.deb root
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core && for deb in fontconfig-config_*.deb fonts-dejavu-core_*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$deb" root; done
mkdir -p /tmp/browser-libs/font-cache
cat > /tmp/browser-libs/fonts.conf <<'"'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/browser-libs/font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF'

/bin/bash -lc "FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/browser-libs/fonts.conf DEBUG=pw:browser LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/browser-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node --input-type=module <<'JS' 2>/tmp/chrome-log
import {chromium} from '@playwright/test'; const b=await chromium.launch({args:['--no-sandbox']}); const p=await b.newPage(); await p.goto('http://localhost:5173'); await b.close();
JS
rg -i 'fatal|error|missing|failed|assert|trap' /tmp/chrome-log | tail -15"
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 && dpkg-deb -x libsqlite3-0_*.deb root'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'text-color|background-color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Popup/Popup.css | head -55"

/bin/bash -lc "cat >> src/styles.css <<'EOF'
.app-shell{background:#f7f8f6}.actions-button,.save-button{--g-button-text-color-hover:#fff;--g-button-background-color:#65774d;--g-button-background-color-hover:#586b41}.actions-popup{--g-popup-background-color:#fff;--g-popup-border-radius:9px;--g-popup-border-color:#e3e7dc}
EOF
npx --yes prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});\""
